lines.scene: EXT. NEW YORK SIDE STREET - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Oh God, I’m -- I’m sorry. But I can’t stop. I can’t stop.

lines.scene: INT. HUGHIE’S FAMILY APARTMENT - QUEENS - DAY
lines.dialogue: My deepest condolences to Robin Ward’s family. I was chasing those bank robbers... and she just... stepped into the middle of the street... and I couldn’t...
Sorry, baby, but when I get inside a girl, I get inside a girl.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: No. No way.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: So some dude can blubber all over me? I’m -- not good in situations like that. No.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: The hell is that supposed to mean?

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Fuck. You’ve got four points?

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - TWENTY MINUTES LATER
lines.dialogue: Hey, man. I’m sorry what happened to your girlfriend. Alright?

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - TWENTY MINUTES LATER
lines.dialogue: Buddy. You okay?
Dope.
I had to sell it. I’m going 10-1. DEANNA I can’t find her.
What are you doing here?
What do you mean?
Okay, cool. Whose? Help?
Hmm. Well, Mr. Adana. I mean, Deep invited me here. Having a, I don’t know, a real nice lunch.
...What?
Uh, hell no.
I’m a Baptist, okay -- I saw that documentary about y’all -- this ain’t my shit --
How do you know that? He fucking tell you that?
They can’t do that.
Fuck you!
What’s up, shitbirds?
Please, I can cover all the boroughs in three hours. Just went lookin’, that’s all.
My heart’s just fine. Take a step closer and I’ll show you.
We’re even, bitch.
Everything makes a lot more sense now, don’t it.
Church of the Collective files. But I didn’t get it. I wasn’t here. You got this shit on your own, yeah?
I want back in. So I need her out. Fuck that Nazi bitch.
PDR?
Sir, I can explain --
Wait. Does this mean --
Fuck yeah! The A-Train is back baby!
FUCK YES THEY DID! Seee ya, bitch!
